request.prompt:
Goods: LDPE film-grade granules
Country of origin: KR

Chosen so far: 39 Plastics and articles thereof > 3901 Polymers of ethylene, in primary forms

Choose the subheading that covers these goods. Options:
- 390110: Ethylene polymers; in primary forms, polyethylene having a specific gravity of less than 0.94
- 390140: Ethylene polymers; in primary forms, ethylene-alpha-olefin copolymers, having a specific gravity of less than 0.94

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: LDPE film-grade granules are low-density polyethylene (specific gravity below 0.94) in primary form, which falls under 390110 rather than the ethylene-alpha-olefin copolymers of 390140 (such as LLDPE).
